qualifications: All profiles include construction, deep-copy/checksum, startup and runtime GC.
Self counts exclude callees; inclusive counts contain callees and must not be summed with them.
Recursive function variants with apostrophe suffixes are excluded from headline tables; inclusive recursive counts overlap.
Top-level copy/checksum inclusive attribution depends on where GC runs; use whole-program totals and runtime self counts for comparisons.
Parent-to-main spans #821 and later changes; the total instruction delta is not attributed exclusively to #821.
Counter profiles separately count AOT processing between snapshots 1 and 2, and do not directly measure JIT allocations or instructions.
